safetyChecklist: Equity and unrealized P/L breaches can happen before stop orders fill
Distinguish hard breaches versus soft daily pauses
Use actual account-specific EOD/session/timezone; never assume calendar UTC day
Include commissions, swaps and platform/instrument exposure
Respect stage- and size-specific maximum contracts or broker margin
News, copy trading, IP, EA, hedge, weekend and holding restrictions vary
On funded stages check payout buffer and withdrawal impact on loss floor
Leave a cushion for spread, slippage, gaps and multiple correlated positions
Never infer a risk-per-trade allowance solely from account nominal size
